service.name: Crystalline Conflict Rank Boost
service.longDescription: PvP Ranked Boost ranging from Bronze to Crystal — grab a boost to your desired rank and acquire Adventurer Plate designs and more. Each PvP season resets with a major patch, and your end-of-season rank determines the loot you get.

rewards.title: PvP Rank Boost
rewards.text: Acquire a rank boost to your desired rank and get exclusive loot based on it.

rewards.title: Adventurer Plate Designs
rewards.text: Exclusive Adventurer Plate Designs from PvP ranks.

rewards.title: PvP Currency
rewards.text: Wolf Marks and Trophy Crystals to exchange for your favourite weapons and glamour.

rewards.title: Be on the leaderboard!
rewards.text: High ranks put you on the official FFXIV leaderboard, up to Top 300.
